svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A bought IP67 box, 80 x 60 x 45 mm, holding the reader board.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Base (the face that goes against the guard web): two 4 mm holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50 mm apart on the long centre line, matching the web holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seal under each screw head with a nylon washer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Downslope end: one 20.5 mm hole, centred, for the M20 conduit

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fitting that carries the bus out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upslope end: one 12.5 mm hole for an M12 gland for the sensor lead.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit the reader board on its standoffs; terminate the sensor lead

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the bus in lever connectors as the bus diagram shows.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: hangs under the guard web at the upslope end, lid down,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 mm clear of the upslope pin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lid gasket seated; the box hangs level.
